data.description: This use case focuses on gathering zero-party data and obtaining email/SMS consents from first-time website visitors by offering discounts in return. This strategy significantly enriches your understanding of your customer base, allowing for more personalized interactions in the future.
data.name: Interactive Subscriber Banner

template.callout: "Select one of these four zero-party banners to enhance your customer database. The interactive banner proved to be a valuable tool for optimizing data collection and improving overall customer experience."

fulfillments.description: Banner featuring two 'zero-party' questions: 'Number Scale Question' and 'Card Options Question'. The final step involves subscribing and providing consent for email/SMS communications. Below, additional versions of this banner are available. The primary difference between these versions is the order of the questions. The banner is fully customizable, allowing you to tailor it to your design preferences and to edit the various questions and answers as needed.
fulfillments.headline: Banner - version 1

fulfillments.description: After launching the campaign, you can return to this evaluation dashboard to see the real-time campaign performance results. Make sure to fill in the parameters inside the dashboard e.g. campaign_name and email/SMS consent categories.

fulfillments.description: This report displays the responses submitted for the 'Number Scale' question. Please rename this report to reflect your 'Number Scale' question accurately. No further edits to the report are required
fulfillments.headline: Report on the 'Number Scale' Question

fulfillments.description: This report shows the answers submitted for the 'Picture Scale' question. Please rename this report to mirror your 'Picture Scale' question. No further edits are necessary in the report.
fulfillments.headline: Report on the 'Picture Scale' Question

fulfillments.description: This report shows the answers submitted for the 'Card Options' question. Please rename this report to mirror your 'Card Options' question. In the second step, please rename the metrics to reflect the answers to your question. The first metric corresponds to the first answer, and so on.
fulfillments.headline: Report on the 'Card Options' Question
